name: Vizcom
summary: AI design tool that turns sketches into photorealistic 3D product renders, with prompt-based iteration and animation.
description: Vizcom is an AI-powered design tool for product and industrial designers. Sketch a concept and get photorealistic renders in seconds, then iterate with prompts: variate form, color and style, edit or enhance any image, swap materials and scenes on 3D models, and animate the result. A free Starter plan (800 credits) sits in front of Professional at $49/month and Enterprise tiers.
contains: turn sketches into photorealistic renders in seconds
prompt-based iteration: variate form, color and style
image editing, enhancement and animation tools
3D model visualisation with material and scene swaps
free Starter plan with 800 credits per month
Professional $49 per month: 20,000 credits, 4K export, live render
Enterprise: SSO, audit logs, custom security
Education plan for students and educators
